The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''27,987 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''8,466 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, [[Rupe]] was serving as the [[Je'daii Temple Master]] of [[Stav Kesh]].<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
